item.coloph: zhi khro lha yi rdzong 'khor zhes bya ba/ gshen tshangs pa 'od 'gyed kyis/ zhi khro rtsangs gzungs gzhi bzung nas gsungs pa'o/ khod spungs yan chad bsnyan (snyan) du brgyud do/ khod spungs kyis phyi rabs don du yi ger bkod pa ste/ phyi rabs gshen rabs don du/ zang zang lha brag la yum sras lnga la rtad (gtad) do/ u ya/ shog gu sum rtubs dmar ser sum ldebs la/ yig 'phring (phreng) brgya' dang rtsa brgyad yod do//
